# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c11 P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021), [v3 c1 P1](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless, freckled face. He has a habit of grinning when spoken to.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Billy is exceedingly shy, quiet, and possesses a painful lack of conversational gifts, often chuckling or grinning instead of speaking. Despite his stoic and unexpressive demeanor, he is good-natured and a hard worker. He is easily intimidated when it comes to courtship, preferring others to act on his behalf.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Traits

- Shy and quiet  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- Good-natured and hardworking  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farm labor  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry and establish his own farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews grows up in Avonlea and attends the local school alongside his sister Jane and other village youth. As a young man, he drives his double-seated buggy to local events, such as the concert at the White Sands Hotel. Long enamored with Anne Shirley, his extreme shyness prevents him from courting her directly. When his father grants him the upper Andrews farm, Billy asks his sister Jane to propose to Anne on his behalf. After Anne declines the proposal, Billy turns his attentions to Nettie Blewett, whom he eventually marries.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P23](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0023), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
